segments.name: Grocery
segments.description: Runs natural and organic grocery stores and sells dietary supplements to consumers seeking healthier daily choices.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single reportable segment, as the CODM reviews financial performance and makes decisions on a consolidated basis.

revenueModel.text: Store shoppers pay for groceries and supplements at the point of sale, and vendors pay for advertising in its sales channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Retail Sales: At the point of sale when payment is received, products are physically transferred, and title passes.
